browser_history_changed_in_another_tab_r: Browser history changed in another tab. Refresh this page when your quiz is finished.
full_historical_statistics_are_available: Full historical statistics are available only to signed-in users. Guest statistics aggregate the most recent five quizzes; without browser storage they last only for this visit.
showing_cumulative_account_statistics_pl: Showing cumulative account statistics, plus any unsaved recent practice from this device. Latest results provide a comparison point.
older_browser_statistics_were_imported_i: Older browser statistics were imported into your account. They contain rolling answers and latest results, not dated quiz sessions.
import_failed_browser_history_was_kept_7: Import failed. Browser history was kept.
no_older_browser_statistics_were_found_t: No older browser statistics were found to import.
turn_on_historical_statistics_storage_be: Turn on historical statistics storage before importing.
new_quizzes_will_not_be_saved_to_your_ac: New quizzes will not be saved to your account. Existing account history is retained.
new_completed_quizzes_will_be_saved_to_y: New completed quizzes will be saved to your account.
the_preference_could_not_be_saved_please: The preference could not be saved. Please retry.
statistics_have_not_synchronized_keep_th: Statistics have not synchronized. Keep this tab open and retry when connected; pending results are retained within the browser limit.
account_statistics_synchronized_the_brow: Account statistics synchronized. The browser keeps at most five recent quizzes when allowed.
historical_storage_is_off_this_quiz_rema: Historical storage is off. This quiz remains in recent browser history only.
more_than_five_quizzes_are_waiting_to_up: More than five quizzes are waiting to upload. Keep this tab open and reconnect; only five can survive a reload.
the_account_changed_during_this_quiz_so_: The account changed during this quiz, so its result was not uploaded.
account_statistics_could_not_load_recent: Account statistics could not load. Recent results and unimported browser history have been kept.
browser_storage_is_unavailable_new_resul: Browser storage is unavailable. New results remain in memory for this visit.
recent_browser_statistics_could_not_be_r: Recent browser statistics could not be read. Older browser history has been preserved.
